exposure: Low dose sufentanil (5 mg intravenous infusion)
Normal saline (1 mL intravenous infusion, placebo)
cohort: Patients undergoing cesarean delivery who received carboprost to manage conditions like refractory uterine atony or severe postpartum hemorrhage.
finding: The prophylactic use of low dose sufentanil significantly reduced the incidence of nausea, vomiting, and gastrointestinal discomfort associated with carboprost administration during cesarean section.
